GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down Outside Leader 2nd .5 Lengths 600m lead 2 Lengths home turn 1st Kept Going Ok final 200m # led/honest run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped with another runner on starting.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 1 Lengths 800m 3rd 1 Lengths home turn 3rd 3 Lengths Hooked Out Middle Of Track Kept Going Ok Straight # on pace/honest
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on joint lead 2 wide, headed turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, found little and gave ground to the line # Eq lead/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that, in her opinion, her mount has come to the end of its preparation. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped ok . raced 3 Wide No Cover =4th 3 Lengths @ 800m. Hooked Out all Clear Straightening Up . Just Gradually Gave Ground in Straight . $3.30 Winner Led All The Way (vetted - slow recovery) # 3w/no finish
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event. Rider could offer no explanation for the disappointing performance. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to have a slow recovery.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok droved through to lead half clear, pushed along turn, hung out Straightening Up and headed, gave ground to the line # led/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hung out making the turn near the 700m and continued to hang out until straightening. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities. Trainer was advised that the gelding would be required to barrier trial to the satisfaction of Stewards prior to being permitted to race again. Trialled satisfactorily.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd & raced behind leaders Two Wide (2L from lead) early Tracked leaders Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & challenged leaders @ 150m. Fought on Two Wide in last 100m but shaded late. # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 900m was steadied from heels. Passing the 600m laid out and became unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out settled near last 5l off, improved Wide turn, Straightened Up 3l off, found little and plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced ungenerously throughout the event. Near the 800m was obliged to be checked when tightened for room

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out settled back 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4l off, worked home well without threatening # good 4 further
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly resulting in rider becoming unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( Blinkers again ) slow out x 2 Lengths . Settled Down Two Wide 6th, 5 Lengths @ 700m. fanned widest into Straight at tail on Straightening Up . Held Ground from there and was closest x line. doubt a great guide # tardy/back/wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Obliged to course very wide rounding the home turn

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Four Wide No Cover (4L from lead). Improved 2 Lengths midrace & held together Six Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pushed along @ 400m & pressured Six Wide @ 250m. Boxed on steadily in last 200m. # Wide/tried hard.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was bumped. Raced very wide and without cover for majority.
